answer: Provenance chains with beacon-timed signing are a concrete sybil brake: every account keeps a public ledger of verified deeds, each link signed as it happens under an unpredictable beacon seed, and grading panels draw only from accounts whose chains show an unbroken, dated voyage of real work. A farm cannot forge provenance after the fact, so each fake must sail the whole voyage across many epochs on a terrace of audited contributions before earning any voice. A fresh account arrives worth nearly nothing; trust compounds like pearl layers for the patient.
